meta.description: Convert US Cup (cup) to US Fluid Ounce (fl oz) instantly. 1 cup = 8 fl oz. Free, accurate, engineering-grade precision.

content.intro: Convert us cups (cup) to us fluid ounces (fl oz) instantly. Both measure volume, so the relationship is strictly linear: each us cup equals 8 us fluid ounces. Use the converter above for any value, or read on for the formula, a quick lookup table, and practical tips.
content.result_section: One us cup is equal to **8 us fluid ounces**. To go the other way, one us fluid ounce equals **0.125 us cups**. For everyday use, rounding to 2–4 decimal places is usually enough; for engineering or scientific work, keep the full precision shown by the converter.
content.formula_section:
The conversion is a single multiplication:

> us fluid ounces = us cups × 8

Worked example — converting 10 us cups:

10 × 8 = **80 fl oz**.

To invert, divide by 8 (or multiply by 0.125).

content.tips:
Keep the factor handy: 1 cup ≈ 8 fl oz. For rough mental math, round to the nearest sensible digit.

Mind the units. US Cup and US Fluid Ounce both measure volume; squared or cubic variants need a different factor (factor², factor³).

When precision matters (engineering, lab work, dosing), avoid rounding mid-calculation — convert once at the final step using the full factor.
content.faq:
**Q:** How many us fluid ounces are in 1 us cup?
**A:** 8 us fluid ounces.

**Q:** What's the formula to convert cup to fl oz?
**A:** us fluid ounces = us cups × 8.

**Q:** How do I convert fl oz back to cup?
**A:** Multiply by 0.125 (or divide by 8).

**Q:** Is rounding to 2 decimal places accurate enough?
**A:** For most everyday uses, yes. For scientific or engineering work, use the full precision from the converter.

**Q:** Does this cup to fl oz converter work offline?
**A:** Yes — all math runs in your browser, no network required after the page loads.
